title: GC–MS
caption: Gas chromatography separates a mixture in time; each compound then enters the mass spectrometer, which records its spectrum. Matching the retention time and the mass spectrum against a library identifies the compound, as in drug testing and forensic analysis.
alt: A flow: sample injected → GC column separates → each compound in turn ionised → mass spectrum → library match.
description: The GC column separates components by retention time.
Each component is ionised and its mass spectrum recorded.
The spectrum and retention time are matched to a database.
